- PostgreSQL

Nice to have: LangChain, vector DB ops, MCP tooling

Engagement: independent contractor (B2B), long-term
Remote: worldwide; overlap 09:00-17:00 UTC
AI tools: allowed. Subcontracting: not required. No exclusivity.
Application: email your CV to jobs@beaconanalytics.example

notes: Clean positive: ICA, in-band rate, 8h overlap, AI allowed.
